About Me

Why To Choose ARC

Abdul Rehman Cheema

Abdul Rehman Cheema is a Career Mentor with 5+ years of experience in counseling and content creation, having guided 500+ clients across 10+ countries. Currently pursuing a BS in Psychology through Virtual University, he blends psychology, neuroscience and Islamic principles with practical life experience to help people make clearer career decisions. He looks at your background, strengths and challenges, weighs real opportunities, and builds a clear, logical direction forward. With a community of around 1 million people, his aim is to move you from confusion to clarity.

Certifications

Pursuing BS in Psychology at Virtual University, with 5+ years of practical experience guiding people through physical, mental, social, financial and spiritual challenges.

Unbiased Approach

Providing a neutral, empathetic, and confidential environment where both parties are truly heard.

Psychology & Shariah

Bridging the gap between empirical science and theological principles for holistic healing.
